cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

mechanism: A treats the rule-holder concession as a decision A can direct and preserve, securing one exception that A immediately frames as a precedent.
confusable: Simple entitlement or rule-breaking is confusable: B must actually grant a limited exception, and A must use that decision as grounds for future repetition.
comparison: Cafe bicycle exception must survive a different counter worker; deadline extension becomes a first test of a previously untried policy.
seedUse: All four canonical seeds read. Preserve actual rain condition and limited one-day extension; make A assumed authority act on how B exception is recorded and used.
